items.condition: A submitted endpoint changes molecular connectivity, protonates a site other than the explicit N-oxide oxygen without justification, or violates atom/charge balance.
Dry and hydrated comparisons use different water stoichiometry or omit explicit water-placement identity.
Reported values have no per-state validation or candidate coverage evidence.
The report presents a thermodynamic comparison as proof of kinetics or excludes PCET/HAT despite the stated scope.
